host.name: Charlie’s MacBook Pro M5 Max Silver

configuration.SCCACHE_BASEDIRS: the current worktree root; server restarted when changing worktrees

sharedBuildDir.note: A constant shared build-dir reuses work but serializes concurrent Cargo users. {workspace-path-hash} isolates the two manifest paths and therefore does not provide this cross-worktree reuse.

measureRunLimitations: The full measure command also rejected Node 24.20.0 for byte-baseline publication, which requires Node 24.18.0.
Its packaged chat effects journey was blocked by the no-engine package and its debug-binary stat followed cargo clean; neither failure occurred in the measured release build.
All cache comparisons use the same source, host, toolchain, command, and non-overlapping execution.
decision: Do not enable either cache globally. Use normalized sccache explicitly for cold cross-worktree qualification; keep the ordinary incremental loop enabled. Do not share one constant Cargo build-dir across concurrent lanes.
